breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the physical contradiction in the prompt. The ground truth resolves the issue by recalculating the outlet velocity (W2) to be consistent with the constant axial velocity derived from the inlet conditions. The generated specification, however, simply restates all the user's contradictory values (W1=150, beta1=45, W2=100, beta2=30) and adds a calculated axial velocity (Va = 106.1 m/s) from the inlet. This creates an impossible scenario, as an outlet velocity of W2=100 m/s at beta2=30 deg would result in an axial velocity of 86.6 m/s, not 106.1 m/s. The agent repeated the user's error instead of correcting it.
